support_tree_enforce_initial_layer_diame.label: Enforce Initial Layer Diameter
support_tree_enforce_initial_layer_diame.description: Increase tip diameter for support close to the buildplate to enable said branch to reach initial layer diameter. Improves support close to the buildplate.

support_cradle_enable.label: Enable Cradle
support_cradle_enable.description: Enable placing cradles around parts to prevent parts from falling over while printing.

support_cradle_generation.label: Automatic Cradle Generateion
support_cradle_generation.description: Automatic placment of cradles around pointy overhangs. If disabled only manually placed cradles will generate.

support_cradle_height.label: Cradle Height
support_cradle_height.description: The height of the cradle to support pointy overhangs. The cradle will stop generating if the pointy part of the model connects with another part of the model that either rests on the buildplate or already has its own cradle. A larger cradle height reduces failures of pointy overhangs but increases material usage and print time and alco can make the support harder to remove.

support_cradle_min_height.label: Minimum Cradle Height
support_cradle_min_height.description: The minimum height of the cradle to support pointy overhangs. Cradles that would be smaller than this will not generate

support_cradle_line_count.label: Cradle Lines
support_cradle_line_count.description: The Cradle consists of lines leading away from the model. This is the amount of lines that should be generated around the model. Highter amount of lines reduces failures of pointy overhangs but increases material usage and print time and alco can make the support harder to remove.

support_cradle_length.label: Cradle Length
support_cradle_length.description: Length of the lines of the cradle. Inreasing this increases material usage and print time, but makes the cradle more sturdy.

support_cradle_min_length.label: Minimum Cradle Length
support_cradle_min_length.description: Sometimes cradle lines are shorter than desired e.g. when they would collide with another cradle line. Cradle lines smaller than this are removed

support_cradle_line_width.label: Cradle Line Width
support_cradle_line_width.description: Width of the lines of the cradle. Inreasing this increases material usage and print time, but makes the cradle more sturdy. If increases so much that the lines touch and become one area it will make the support very hard to remove.

support_cradle_area_threshold.label: Cradle Threshold
support_cradle_area_threshold.description: Area required for a pointy overhang to cause a cradle to be generated.

support_cradle_base_diameter.label: Cradle Base Support Area Diameter
support_cradle_base_diameter.description: Size of the base below the cradle.

support_cradle_xy_height_0.label: Cradle XY Height 1
support_cradle_xy_height_0.description: The height of the 1. part of the cradle. The custom cradle xy distance will be applied from the previous part of the cradle for this amount of height.

support_cradle_xy_dist_0.label: Cradle XY Distance 1
support_cradle_xy_dist_0.description: Distance between cradle lines and model on the 1. part of the cradle

support_cradle_xy_height_1.label: Cradle XY Height 2
support_cradle_xy_height_1.description: The height of the 2. part of the cradle. The custom cradle xy distance will be applied from the previous part of the cradle for this amount of height.

support_cradle_xy_dist_1.label: Cradle XY Distance 2
support_cradle_xy_dist_1.description: Distance between cradle lines and model on the 2. part of the cradle

support_cradle_xy_height_2.label: Cradle XY Height 3
support_cradle_xy_height_2.description: The height of the 3. part of the cradle. The custom cradle xy distance will be applied from the previous part of the cradle for this amount of height.

support_cradle_xy_dist_2.label: Cradle XY Distance 3
support_cradle_xy_dist_2.description: Distance between cradle lines and model on the 2. part of the cradle
support_cradle_xy_dist_2.enabled: support_enable and support_cradle_enable and support_cradle_xy_height_1 > 0 and support_cradle_xy_height_2 > 0

support_cradle_z_distance.label: Cradle Z Distance
support_cradle_z_distance.description: The Z Distance between the cradle-lines and the support it is supported by. Increasing makes cradle lines easier to remove

support_tree_large_cradle_line_tips.label: Large Cradle Line Tips
support_tree_large_cradle_line_tips.description: Generate large tips below the cradle lines.

support_tree_support_skin_height.label: Support Skin Height
support_tree_support_skin_height.description: Height of Support Skin generated to support cradle/interface/model parts that would fall inside of a support area. Increasing this increases material usage and print time. Skin height will be rounded up towards the next multiple of layer-height. Using a support top distance that is not a multiple of layer-height will increase the skin height by less than one layer height.

support_tree_support_skin_line_distance.label: Support Skin Line Distance
support_tree_support_skin_line_distance.description: Distance between lines of the support skin.
support_tree_support_skin_line_distance.enabled: support_enable and support_structure=='tree' and support_tree_support_skin_height >= layer_height

support_tree_skin_for_large_tips_thresho.label: Support Skin for Tips Threshold
support_tree_skin_for_large_tips_thresho.description: Generate support skin for any tips that have at least this diameter.
support_tree_skin_for_large_tips_thresho.enabled: support_enable and support_structure=='tree' and support_tree_support_skin_height >= layer_height

support_cradle_direction.label: Cradle Line Direction
support_cradle_direction.description: Determines the location the cradle lines point to. Center of mass means all cradle lines will point towards a single point, the center of mass of the to be supported outline. Closest outline means that the cradle lines will point towards the outline resulting in a larger distance between cradle connections as different lines may point towards different points.

support_cradle_roof.label: Cradle Roof Type
support_cradle_roof.description: How the cradle should behave if roof is active. None means the cradle will generate using regular support. Cradle means only the cradle lines will be roof. Cradle and base means thet the Cradle Lines as well as the area below them and the pointy overhang will be roof. Will ignore Minimum Roof Area.

support_side_cradle_enabled.label: Automatic side-cradle generation
support_side_cradle_enabled.description: Place cradles around parts that could bend while printing.

support_side_cradle_stable_diameter.label: Side Cradle Stable Part Diameter
support_side_cradle_stable_diameter.description: Parts that have at least this diameter are assumed to not able to be bend while printing

support_side_cradle_deformation_constant.label: Side Cradle Displacement Constant
support_side_cradle_deformation_constant.description: How easy parts bend, increasing this will cause more side cradles.

support_side_cradle_deformation_threshol.label: Side Cradle Displacement Threshold
support_side_cradle_deformation_threshol.description: After how much displacement side cradles will generate, reducing this will cause more side cradles.

support_side_cradle_xy_factor.label: Side Cradle Displacement Horizontal Factor
support_side_cradle_xy_factor.description: Weighting for horizontal changes in position. Increasing this will cause more side cradles, based on xy position changes
